chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father and a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, all from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Hamza, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed to David (peace be upon him): 'Go to My servant Daniel and say to him, "You disobeyed Me and I forgave you, and you disobeyed Me and I forgave you, and you disobeyed Me and I forgave you. But if you were to disobey Me a fourth time, I will not forgive you."'

So David (peace be upon him) went to him and said, 'O Daniel! Indeed, I am the Messenger of Allah to you, and He is saying to you, "You disobeyed Me and I forgave you, and you disobeyed Me and I forgave you, and you disobeyed Me and I forgave you. But if you were to disobey Me a fourth time, I will not forgive you."' So Daniel said to him, 'You have delivered (the message), O Prophet of Allah!'

So when it was in the early morning, Daniel stood and whispered to his Lord and said, 'O Lord! Your Prophet David informed me that I disobeyed You so You forgave me, and I disobeyed You so You forgave me, and I disobeyed You so You forgave me, and he informed me from You that if I were to disobey You a fourth time, You would not forgive me. So by Your Might, if You do not protect me (from falling into sin), I will surely disobey You, then I will surely disobey You, then I will surely disobey You.'
ai.seo_question: What is the story of Daniel's threefold disobedience and divine forgiveness in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi illustrates the concept of *al-‘Afiyah* (divine protection from sin) through the dialogue between Prophet Dawud and his servant Daniyal, highlighting the psychological tension between fear of losing forgiveness and the inevitability of human weakness. In Shia exegesis, this narrative underscores that even the righteous require continuous divine safeguarding (*‘ismah* in a broad sense) to avoid the 'fourth' transgression, serving as a lesson on humility and reliance on God's mercy rather than self-assurance. The story also reflects the scholarly discussion on whether the 'servant' Daniyal was a prophet or a righteous companion, emphasizing the universality of the struggle against *nafs* (ego).

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and a number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Hamza, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Revealed unto Dawood: “Go to My<sup>azwj</sup> servant Daniel and say to him, “You disobeyed Me<sup>azwj</sup> and I<sup>azwj</sup> Forgave you, so you disobeyed Me<sup>azwj</sup> and I<sup>azwj</sup> Forgave you, so you disobeyed Me<sup>azwj</sup> and I<sup>azwj</sup> Forgave you. But if you were to disobey Me<sup>azwj</sup> fourthly, I<sup>azwj</sup> will not Forgive you”.

So Dawood<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> went over and said: ‘O Daniel! I<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> am a Rasool<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> of Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> to you and He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> is Saying to you “You disobeyed Me<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> and I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Forgave you, so you disobeyed Me<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> and I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Forgave you, so you disobeyed Me<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> and I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Forgave you. But if you were to disobey Me<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> fourthly, I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> will not Forgive you”. So Daniel said to him<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>, ‘You<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> have delivered (the Message), O Prophet<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> of Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>!’.

So when it was the next morning, Daniel stood and whispered to his Lord<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> and he said, ‘O Lord<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>! Dawood<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>, Your<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Prophet<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> informed me that I disobeyed You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> so You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Forgave me, and I disobeyed You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, so You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Forgave me, and I disobeyed You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, so You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Forgave me, and he<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> informed me from You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> that if I were to disobey You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> for the fourth time, You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> will not be Forgiving me. So, by Your<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Might, if You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> will not Defend me, I will (end up) disobeying You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, then I will (end up) disobeying You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, and I (end up) will disobeying You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>’’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and a number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad all from ibn Mahbub from abu Hamza from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:

“Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, sent revelation to David, ‘Meet My servant Daniel and say to him, ‘You have disobeyed Me and I forgave you, you disobeyed Me, I forgave you, you disobeyed Me and I forgave you. If you will disobey Me the forth time I will not forgive you.’

David went to meet Daniel and said, ‘O Daniel, I am the Messenger of Allah and He says to you, “You disobeyed Me and I forgave you, you disobeyed Me and I forgave you, you disobeyed Me and I forgave you. If you will disobey Me the forth time I will not forgive you.’” Daniel said, ‘O prophet of Allah, you have conveyed your message.’

In the early morning Daniel woke up and prayed to his Lord, saying, ‘O Lord, Your prophet David informed me that I have disobeyed You and You forgave me, I disobeyed You and You forgave me, I disobeyed You and You forgave me and if I will disobey You the forth time You will not forgive me. I swear by Your Majesty, if You will not protect me I will certainly disobey You, I will certainly disobey You, I will certainly disobey You.’”
